Definition: an Anakite or descendant of Anak
BiblicalUsage: The Anakim were the descendants of Anak — the giants of the land. Moses tells Israel the Emim who lived in Moab were a people great and many and tall, as the Anakim; and Caleb, at eighty-five, asks for the mountain where the Anakim were and the cities were great and fenced, trusting the LORD would be with him to drive them out. The word is always the giants, and always the question of whether Israel will face them.
TheologicalSignificance: A word for giants carries no doctrine of its own; its weight is the asking — Caleb at eighty-five asking for the mountain where the Anakim were, because the LORD was with him.
